name: Seance kit
body:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 13
Price 290 gp; Weight 12 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This stained mahogany box contains tools that aid in contacting supernatural beings either as part of an act or a genuine ritual. This kit includes a nonmagical spirit planchette set (see Pathfinder Adventure Path #43: The Haunting of Harrowstone 19, or treat as a board gameUE worth 25 gp), 10 candles, 10 candlesticksUE, one entertainer’s outfit, one harrow deckUE, one magnetUE, 10 sticks of incenseARG, one scroll of augury, and two scrolls of prestidigitation.
